name: Lyo.ContentThreatScan.Intel
tagline: Optional **`DefaultContentThreatReputationPipeline`** for Malware Bazaar, VirusTotal, and **`clamd` INSTREAM** (TCP).
description: Optional **`DefaultContentThreatReputationPipeline`** for Malware Bazaar, VirusTotal, and **`clamd` INSTREAM** (TCP).

sections.title: Composition
sections.text: Construct **`DefaultContentThreatReputationPipeline`** with a shared **`HttpClient`** (often from **`IHttpClientFactory`**), `ReputationPipelineOptions` bound from configuration, and an optional `ILogger`. Register the instance as **`IContentThreatReputationPipeline`** wherever **`ContentThreatMalwareScanner`** or other hosts need reputation. Probes are omitted when keys are absent: empty **`VirusTotalApiKey`** skips VT; empty **`MalwareBazaarAuthKey`** skips Bazaar; **`Clamd.Enabled == false`** skips `clamd`.

sections.title: `ReputationPipelineOptions`
rows: API keys; provider is skipped when blank.
Override default base URLs (sovereign clouds, internal proxies).
Score added when MalwareBazaar reports a known sample.
Score multiplied by the number of engines flagging the sample.
Score bumps applied when a provider's `ExternalReputationFailureDisposition` is `TreatAsSuspect` / `ImmediateThreatBump`.
Negative and positive TTLs used by the digest cache.

sections.title: Outages and quotas
items: **`TreatAsSuspect`** — adds `ProviderFailureSuspectBump` under a stable rule id
**`ImmediateThreatBump`** — large contribution capped by disposition options (policy-driven “fail closed”)

sections.title: Digest cache
sections.text: `ReputationDigestLookupCache` is an in-process LRU keyed by lowercase hex SHA-256 (`DigestCacheMaximumEntries`, positive/negative TTL minutes).
